title: Kernel Methods for Stochastic Dynamical Systems with Application to Koopman Eigenfunctions: Feynman-Kac Representations and RKHS Approximation
summary: We extend the unified kernel framework for transport equations and Koopman eigenfunctions, developed in previous work by the authors for deterministic systems, to stochastic differential equations (SDEs). In the deterministic setting, three analytically grounded constructions-Lions-type variational principles, Green's function convolution, and resolvent operators along characteristic flows--were shown to yield identical reproducing kernels.
